'''Reen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] of [[Bels Lank]], a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]] arrived at their [[Lank's farm|farm]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] her father, believing him to be [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], Reen hid until [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents found her. She was sent to [[Oasis (community)|Oasis]] under the care of the [[Dim-U/Legends|Dim-U]] [[Monk/Legends|monks]].
